notablePrerequisites: Blood Vassal does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Blood Vassal by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Blood Vassal dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing the +1/+1 counter from Blood Vassal, targeting any creature.
Repeat.
